newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- A majority of his surgeons think Russian president Boris Yeltsin's current health is too poor to allow for needed heart surgery.

-- Emmanuel Hau, a managing director at EDF state-owned electricity utility starts legal action against EDF chairman and former Economy Minister Edmond Alphandery, who suppressed the post of managing director in move to rein in decision-making.

-- Air France to operate more of its long- and medium-haul flights from its new hub at Paris Charles de Gaulle airport, reduce the number of flights with stopovers, plans shuttle service from Paris to Nice, Marseille and Toulouse.
-- Usinor-Sacilor posts first-half profits down 65 percent from last year due to drop in world steel prices.
-- Insurer UAP to sell a stake in Scor estimated between 26 and 30 percent.
-- Food group Danone and Coca-Cola Foods announce agreement to create chilled fruit juice venture named Minute Maid Danone, aim to sell in 50 countries worldwide.
